assets.subject: Independent Wyrmwatch mariner hat concept
assets.prompt: Create one ORIGINAL stylized fantasy game prop concept from ordinary functional maritime clothing: a practical weatherproof mariner hat with a broad downward-sloping brim, shallow rounded crown, simple stitched dark navy waxed fabric and a plain narrow fastening band. Full single hat isolated in clear three-quarter view, centered with generous margins on perfectly plain white background, no cast shadow. Tactile cloth, readable simple silhouette, hand-painted concept suitable for a future 3D artist. No person, head, face, pipe, ornaments, symbols, lettering, numerals, logo, watermark, border, scenery or extra objects. No dimensions. Do not imitate any existing game asset or artist.
validation_needed: Review whether the modern rain-hat silhouette suits the fantasy harbormaster before choosing it as replacement
Current head GLB also includes a separate pipe; both-part disposition remains open
Head-bone bind-frame fit over braid and face
